name: coinpilot-ios-app
description: Native SwiftUI app for CoinPilot account and activity data

scripts.test:store: swiftc -D COINPILOT_TEST_SIMULATOR_TOKEN_STORE ios/App/App/ServerAddressPolicy.swift ios/App/App/CoinPilotStore.swift ios/App/App/CoinPilotBundledPreview.swift ios/App/App/CoinPilotBundledMarketData.swift ios/App/App/CoinPilotOfflineReplay.swift ios/App/App/CoinPilotOfflineReplayPersistence.swift tests/CoinPilotStoreTests.swift -o /tmp/coinpilot-ios-store-tests && /tmp/coinpilot-ios-store-tests
scripts.ios:build:sim: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' COINPILOT_DATA_MODE=server CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:build:preview: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -sdk iphonesimulator -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' COINPILOT_DATA_MODE=bundled-preview CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.ios:build:mac: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -destination 'platform=macOS' -configuration Debug CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="-" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=YES build
